proposal.original_text: 最大化 x，其中 x 是 0 到 10 之间的整数，并且 2x 不超过 5。整数最优值是多少？

model.question: optimize
assumptions: x in [0,10] as stated in the text

rendering.text:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-fun x () Int)
(assert (>= x 0))
(assert (<= x 10))
(assert (<= (* 2 x) 5))
(check-sat)
(exit)
